evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 2.0 ppm at the end of the ramp.
At growth onset, oxygen was 5.6 ppm and pressure 3.030 Torr.
Oxygen rose to 18.3 ppm and pressure to 3.180 Torr despite nominal argon flow.
Oxygen has risen progressively to 29.7 ppm and pressure to 3.275 Torr, indicating an atmosphere/process anomaly; air ingress is suspected but not uniquely established.
Temperature is 749.6 °C against 750 °C setpoint and argon flow is 100.1 sccm against 100 sccm setpoint.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-integrity test and exhaust-path check are needed to distinguish air ingress from exhaust restriction or other contamination; sample characterization is not yet available.
